records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenues from Advanced Products increased in the third quarter but decreased in the first nine months of fiscal 2021 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The governmental authorities throughout the U.S. and the world have continued to implement numerous measures to contain the virus, including travel bans and restrictions, quarantines, shelter-in-place orders, and business limitations and shutdowns.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our inventory levels as of January 2, 2021 were $4.2 million lower at $300.1 million compared to $304.3 million at March 28, 2020, but the inventory days increased to 118 days at January 2, 2021 from 106 days at March 28, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The higher gross margin percentage for the third quarter of fiscal 2021 was driven primarily by favorable change in the customer mix within our Wireless business and favorable change in end market mix, as the percentage of revenue derived from our Test, Measurement & Emulation business, which has relatively higher gross margin, increased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, COVID-19 has not had a significant impact on our liquidity, cash flows or capital resources.
